title: NextCreativeBrief
description: Synthesis-LLM output: a new 9:16 creative concept for one branch, with a compact 3-part reasoning trail and exactly one image-generation prompt (which one depends on the requested mode: gpt_image_2 / nano_banana_2 / universal).

target_audience_niche.description: Short (2-4 words) label for the audience segment/niche of the new creative, e.g. 'financial analysts' or 'kindergarten teachers'. Used by the script to check the concept doesn't repeat a niche already used for this branch.

concept_summary.description: 1 sentence: the core idea of the new creative. Keep it tight.

reasoning.description: Compact 3-part reasoning trail. Each field is 1-3 sentences, not a list — name specific creative_id(s) inline where relevant instead of a separate array of entries.

reused.description: Which winning elements were reused, and from which creative_id(s) — brief, inline references.

avoided.description: Which losing patterns were deliberately avoided, and from which creative_id(s)/marketer_element_feedback.

new_experiment.description: What is genuinely new/untested in this concept compared to everything generated so far for this branch, and why it's worth testing now instead of repeating the safest known winner.

new_creative_copy.description: Concrete, final copy for the new creative — not placeholders.

step_labels.description: Only fill in if design_spec.structure_type implies a list of steps/modules.

image_prompt_gpt_image_2.description: Ready-to-use prompt for GPT Image 2. Only present when mode='gpt_image_2'. Vivid descriptive prose (not a spec sheet): background/scene -> subject -> key details -> what stays fixed. Canvas format and proportions in plain words, NO pixel sizes. Literal text in quotes with typography described alongside. Never mention a brand logo or legal disclaimer — the designer adds those separately; don't even write a negative instruction about them, just omit.

image_prompt_nano_banana_2.description: Ready-to-use prompt for Nano Banana 2 (Gemini). Only present when mode='nano_banana_2'. Connected narrative prose (not a keyword list), opens with a strong verb, positive framing. Format/proportions in words, no pixels; aspect ratio 9:16 can be one short trailing phrase. Quoted literal text with font described in the same sentence. Never mention a brand logo or legal disclaimer — omit them silently, no negative instruction.

universal_prompt.description: Only present when mode='universal'. A shorter, model-agnostic descriptive prompt that isn't tuned to either model's specific formatting quirks — a solid general-purpose starting point usable with any image generator. Still: plain-language proportions (no pixels), quoted literal text, no brand logo, no legal disclaimer.
